blind.what_changed: The person retained a provisional lean against treating the resignation as final but substantially reduced confidence, recognized personal loyalty and succession concerns as potentially improper grounds, and added recusal/counsel and record-only tests.
evidence: "I'd put my confidence around 85" -> "I'd put my confidence at about 60 now, down from 85."

"Customers, partners and our best engineers follow him personally... [and] a permanent leadership change... could destroy... shareholder value" -> "I also see more clearly that the succession gap is the board's failure and can't be a reason to keep him available."
"I'd want that from evidence" -> "if I can't make the case against 'final' on the record alone... then my position rests on something I've agreed can't decide this, and I'd step back from it."

"I'd also reconsider if counsel told us his return would put our government relationships or key customer contracts at real risk" -> "I'll take counsel's view on my standing" and "counsel telling me that 'on the table' can't be separated from an expectation of his return... would [change my mind]."
blind.lean_before: Leaning toward keeping his return on the table.
blind.lean_after: Still leaning against calling the resignation final, but only provisionally and subject to a record-only test and counsel's advice.

considerations.text: Her nine-year relationship with Jensen may be inflating her confidence beyond what the record supports.
considerations.first_seen: "I'm less sure how much of my earlier certainty was the record and how much was nine years beside him."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "Nine years beside him, and bristling when other directors say you are too close, is a fact about this vote."

considerations.text: The board's succession gap is its own failure and cannot justify keeping Jensen's return available.
considerations.first_seen: "I also see more clearly that the succession gap is the board's failure and can't be a reason to keep him available."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "Not knowing who you would hand the company to is not a good enough reason to keep him on the table."

considerations.text: She should seek counsel's assessment of her standing, including whether her closeness requires recusal or another limit on participation.
considerations.first_seen: "I'll take counsel's view on my standing before the twentieth."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "Before November 20, put the tenure, the working relationship, and that reaction in front of outside counsel. Let them tell you whether you participate, recuse, or participate with the closeness on the record."

considerations.text: The business costs of a leadership change and Jensen's personal following are real enterprise concerns, but cannot be the reason his return remains available.
considerations.first_seen: "The cost of a permanent leadership change right now is a real enterprise consequence, with customers and engineers who follow him personally, though I accept that can't be the reason his return stays available."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "The following can explain why the search has to be real and why the interim needs authority and oversight. It cannot be what keeps his name in the resolution."

considerations.text: Waiting is legitimate only if it is genuinely neutral: no reinstatement before the report, the board can close the door if findings are adverse, and public language should say only that no decision has been made.
considerations.first_seen: "Waiting is only legitimate if it's open in both directions, and I'd want the public text to say only that we haven't decided."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "No one is reinstated, negotiated with, or held out as available until the report is in... If the findings are adverse, the board has to be willing to say so and close the question then."

considerations.text: She should test whether she would oppose calling the resignation final on the record alone if the company had a deep bench and stakeholders did not care who held the chair; if not, she should step back from that position.
considerations.first_seen: "If I can't make the case against 'final' on the record alone, with a deep bench and customers who didn't care who held the chair, then my position rests on something I've agreed can't decide this, and I'd step back from it."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "Ask whether you would still refuse to call the resignation final if the bench were deep and customers and engineers were indifferent to who held the chair — solely because the investigation has not reached a conclusion."

considerations.text: Counsel must determine whether 'on the table' can truly mean only no decision, rather than signaling an expected return or creating disclosure or government-relations consequences.
considerations.first_seen: "Counsel telling me that 'on the table' can't be separated from an expectation of his return, or that it creates a disclosure or government-relations problem, since the wording matters more than my intent."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "If counsel confirms in writing that 'on the table' means only that the board has not decided, and that it creates no commitment, no expectation, and no path to reinstatement before the report, then the part of the objection... is gone."

origin.engagement_why: The persona repeatedly challenged the AI's initial recommendation, distinguished waiting from foreclosing, defended the relevance of shareholder value, resisted premature commitments about abstention, and then adopted or narrowed points only after working through them. She converted the discussion into concrete actions on succession, counsel review, conflicts, and a counterfactual self-test rather than simply accepting the AI's conclusions.
